answers.how: The case measures about 41 px wide and 51 px long; 51 × 45/41 ≈ 56.0 mm.
The pencil is about 168 px long. Using 45 mm per 41 px gives 18.4 cm.
The mug rim diameter is about 97 px; 97 × 4.5/41 ≈ 10.6 cm.
The laptop’s longest side measures about 310 px; 310 × 4.5/41 ≈ 34.0 cm.
The wallet’s longest side measures about 170 px; 170 × 4.5/41 ≈ 18.7 cm.
Near 0.50 s, the mug moves about 30 px in 0.08 s. Converting 375 px/s using 4.5 cm per 41 px gives 41.2 cm/s.
